{{Hatnote|This article is about the Runes from {{BotW}}. For the manga character, see [[Rūn]]. For the abilities in {{TotK}}, see [[Ancient Power]].}} {{Infobox Object |image= File:BotW Rune Distillation.png |caption= A new Rune distillation |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |uses= |comp= [[Ancient Power]] |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Rune|Runes|Series, BotW, AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW, AoC}}{{Cite|Sheikah Slate authenticated. Distilling Rune...|N/A|BotW}}{{Name Ref|AoC}} also known as {{Term/Store|Sheikah Rune|Sheikah Runes|AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|AoC}}{{Cite|Sheikah Runes|Quests|AoC}} are recurring abilities added to the [[Sheikah Slate]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. Runes go unnamed in {{TotK}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Runes are special objects controlled by the [[Sheikah Slate]] that can affect the world around [[Link]]. Runes are obtained from [[Guidance Stone]]s, primarily in [[Ancient Shrine]]s on the [[Great Plateau]], as well as in the [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]]. To obtain a Rune, Link must insert the Sheikah Slate into a pedestal to extract them. Upon extraction, Link can access that Rune's abilities by pressing the L Button and selecting the Rune. Although they are not strictly interactive abilities, other features of the Sheikah Slate are also described as Basic Runes,{{Cite|Purah has fixed the Sheikah Slate, restoring the last of its {{Color BotW|Red|basic runes}} from 100 years ago.|Adventure Log|BotW}}{{Cite|Strange... It doesn't seem like you have the {{Color BotW|Red|basic runes}}...|Purah|BotW}} namely the [[Camera]], [[Hyrule Compendium]], [[Album]],{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}} you're using is the one {{Color BotW|Blue|Princess Zelda}} herself used 100 years ago. Back then, it only had the {{Color BotW|Blue|Camera}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Compendium}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|album runes}}.|Purah|BotW}} [[Sheikah Sensor]],{{Cite|The Sheikah Sensor is one of the basic runes found on the Sheikah Slate.|Sheikah Sensor Notes|BotW}} and [[Sheikah Sensor +]].{{Cite|The Sheikah Sensor + is a rune that expands the features of the normal Sheikah Sensor.|Sheikah Sensor Notes|BotW}} These Basic Runes were the only Runes known 100 years prior, and were damaged in the time being, but [[Purah]] discovered the existence of others, unbeknownst to her available in the Ancient Shrines, in ancient texts while Link was recovering in the [[Shrine of Resurrection]].{{Cite|After you were defeated by Ganon and we sealed you and the {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}} in the {{Color BotW|Blue|Shrine of Resurrection}}... I discovered additional runes while reading through some ancient texts. {{Color BotW|Blue|Cryonis}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|Stasis}}, for example.|Purah|BotW}} Additionally, [[Purah]] herself created an anti-aging Rune to use on her own self-made Sheikah Slate.{{Cite|The beta version of my anti-aging rune is complete. I have already added it to the Sheikah Slate I made for myself.|Purah's Diary|BotW}} While Link was recovering, Purah researched how to upgrade Runes.{{Cite|Around the time Granté turned three, a letter from Dr. Purah arrived. It was a shock to receive it.
The last time she'd written, it was to talk about an assistant from Kakariko Village, whom she felt was useless.
She was writing now to let me know she'd completed research on powering up the runes, like Stasis.
Hearing this reinvigorated my interest in researching ancient soldier gear.|Robbie's Memoirs|BotW}} Link can upgrade the [[Stasis]], [[Remote Bomb]], and [[Sheikah Sensor]] Runes into the [[Stasis +]], [[Remote Bomb +]], and [[Sheikah Sensor +]] Runes respectively by providing Purah with [[Ancient Material]]s.{{Cite|If you bring me some ancient materials, I'll power up your runes!|Purah|BotW}} The [[Master Cycle Zero]] is accessible alongside the other Runes and functions similarly, though it is unclear if it actually is considered one.{{Cite|The power within prevailed! You proved your worthiness to Monk Maz Koshia by completing all of the Divine Beast Tamer's Trials. Your gift, the Master Cycle Zero, can be found with your Runes.|Adventure Log|BotW}} ====List of Runes==== {| class="wikitable sortable" cellpadding="4" style="text-align:center; width: 100%;" !width="20%"| Item !width="40%" class="unsortable"| Description !width="40%" class="unsortable"| Obtention |- | [[File:BotW Magnesis Icon.png|link=Magnesis]]

Things that can be logged include wildlife, monsters, ingredients, and weapons.'' | style="text-align:left;"|[[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]] |- | '''[[Album]]''' |style="text-align:left"| N/A | style="text-align:left;"|[[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]] |- | [[File:BotW Sheikah Sensor Icon.png|link=Sensor#Breath of the Wild]]
'''[[Sheikah Sensor]]''' |style="text-align:left"| '''''Sheikah Sensor'''{{List Note|name="Tips"}}
Use this power to detect the location of shrines. Simply head in the direction where the reading is strongest.'' | style="text-align:left;"|[[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]] |- | [[File:BotW Sheikah Sensor + Icon.png|link=Sensor +#Breath of the Wild]]
'''[[Sheikah Sensor +]]''' |style="text-align:left"| '''''Sheikah Sensor +'''{{List Note|name="Tips"}}
The Sheikah Sensor + can detect objects that are logged in your Hyrule Compendium.'' | style="text-align:left;"|[[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]] - Provide {{Amounts|BotW|3 Ancient Screw}} |} {{List Notes}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== The four ability Runes featured on the Sheikah Slate in {{BotW}} do not appear in {{TotK}}, having been functionally replaced by new [[Ancient Power]]s used by the [[Right Arm]]. However, the basic Runes from the former reappear as features of the [[Purah Pad]]: the [[Camera]], [[Hyrule Compendium]], [[Album]], and [[Sensor]]/[[Sensor +]], though they are not explicitly described as "Runes". The [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo Ability]] also returns as an Ancient Power accessed through the Right Arm rather than the Purah Pad. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * If [[Link]] manages to reach the goal of any of the first four [[Ancient Shrine]]s without obtaining its Rune, the [[Sheikah Monk]] will instruct him to go back and extract it from the [[Guidance Stone]] before being able to complete the Shrine.{{Cite|Extract the Rune from the Guidance Stone, and then return.|Oman Au|BotW}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Camera Rune Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A promotional image featuring Link using the Camera Rune posted to Nintendo's Twitter File:BotW Rune Pedestal.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Rune Pedestal File:BotW Magnesis Effect.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link using the Magnesis Rune File:BotW Stasis Effect.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link using the Stasis Rune File:BotW Stasis Acceleration.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link creating Stasis Acceleration File:BotW Cryonis Effect.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link using the Cryonis Rune File:BotW Remote Bomb 2.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link using the Bomb Rune {{Ref| }} {{Categories |items= BotW, AoC }}
